key_notes: Key 1 (t=1.2s): Initial archival pose of floor-lamp; Quick, Draw! + Rotoscope centerline established.

Key 3 (t=3.56s): Peak dynamic extension of floor-lamp over 7-plane multiplane environment.
Key 4 (t=4.8s): Follow-through and settle of floor-lamp with watertight SAM cel backing.
why_continuous: Continuous 3.6s archival shot of floor-lamp (1.2s..4.8s) selected by edge clarity and temporal coherence.
